notes.within: mean pairwise cosine of row i across the 32 images, then median / p10 over i
notes.ent: row entropy / log 256; ent_median = median over (image, position)
notes.kl_ratio: per position mean_m KL(P||U) / mean_m KL(P||M), then median over positions; M includes the image itself (as specified); _loo uses the leave-one-out mean
notes.kernel: 31x31 offset kernel averaged from M, row-normalized, cosine to M per row
notes.step_cos: cosine of M[s] vs M[s+1] (s1) and M[s+5] (s5) per row, median; NaN where undefined
